subject.title: fix(proxy-capture): time out stalled CONNECT upstreams

question: Should debug-proxy CONNECT upstream openings have a fixed 30-second deadline that converts a stalled connection attempt into a 504 response?
rationale: The implementation and real-run evidence support the mechanics, but selecting an unconditional runtime deadline changes the availability contract for users whose upstream TCP handshakes legitimately exceed that interval.

options.title: Accept the bounded opening deadline
options.body: Rebase or inspect the final merge result and land the existing 30-second opening-only timeout, keeping successfully connected tunnels unlimited.

options.title: Choose a different product contract
options.body: Pause this PR to define a different timeout duration or explicit configuration policy before changing existing stalled-CONNECT behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded opening deadline
recommendation.body: Rebase or inspect the final merge result and land the existing 30-second opening-only timeout, keeping successfully connected tunnels unlimited.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history only provides adjacent ownership evidence for the proxy-capture area, so this routing recommendation is low confidence.
